A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a method to objectively quantify the effect of radiation-induced damage on a protein structure.
we have developed a pipeline for the automatic calculation of the radiation damage effect on individual atoms of a macromolecular complex.

we have developed a pipeline that automatically calculates a per-atom damage metric, Dloss, from a series of data sets, each collected from the same crystal at increasing dose, and then applies this metric to a structure that contains simultaneously an uncomplex protein and its complexed form.

the effects of radiation are highly site specific and that the most affected atoms are those in the active sites, which is a finding that has been reported before.
